- Diverse product portfolio across multiple end-markets and geographies, insulating against single-industry cyclicality.

business.body: Pradeep Metals Limited (PML) manufactures intricate closed-die forgings in stainless, alloy, carbon, and nickel alloy steels, supplied as finished and semi-finished machined components. The Company specializes in custom-made, small-quantity orders with industry-leading short lead times, serving a diversified base of domestic and export customers. Its wholly owned US subsidiary and step-down subsidiary provide trading, marketing, and manufacturing support in the international market.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Valves:** Forged valve components
- **General Engineering:** Custom forged engineering parts
- **Instrumentation & Flanges:** Forged instrumentation parts and flanges
- **Defense:** Precision-engineered defense components, artillery shell casings

business.body:
- Specialization in custom-made, small-quantity orders with extremely short lead times (as low as 2 days), creating high customer switching costs.
- Diverse product portfolio across multiple end-markets and geographies, insulating against single-industry cyclicality.
- Pass-through contracts for major raw material (steel), mitigating input price volatility risk.
- Metallurgical expertise and precision manufacturing capabilities, particularly for high-quality defense forgings.
business.title: Competitive strengths

outlook.body:
- Expand machining capacity and replace older forging equipment to enhance productivity, quality, and support long-term growth.
- Increase share of value-added machined components and strengthen customer relationships.
- Drive operational efficiencies through cost reduction and waste minimization.
- Develop a scalable, export-oriented defense platform leveraging metallurgical expertise and precision manufacturing.
- Invest in vendor development, particularly in machining, to complement in-house capabilities and improve scalability.
- Pursue innovation-led initiatives such as mill scale recycling, nearing readiness for scale-up.
- The Company has a Dividend Distribution Policy. The Directors have recommended a Final Dividend for the financial year in accordance with this policy.
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: The Board has recently approved an investment of up to Rs. 250 Crores for setting up a Greenfield Manufacturing Facility at Butibori, Nagpur aimed at catering to the rapidly growing global demand for defense equipment arising from evolving geopolitical dynamics (with a particular focus on precision-engineered defense components such as artillery shell casings that require high-quality forging). The Management is also planning to expand machining capacity further to meet increased customer demand.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Management expects to expand machining capacity further to meet increased customer demand.
- New customer acquisitions, a more diversified product mix, effective cost optimization, and disciplined management practices drove revenue and profitability growth.
- Europe's decision to materially enhance defense spending and India's expanding defense cooperation with European nations are expected to create sustained export opportunities.
- India's emergence as a reliable, cost-competitive manufacturing base amid global supply chain diversification positions the Company favourably.
- Strong domestic demand, infrastructure development, and government initiatives like NIP and PLI for Specialty Steel are expected to support sustained demand for forged components.
